fixtures.note: RAISED 143 -> 151 by the constraint=false port, deliberately and with the cause identified. The constraint placement itself is byte-exact: our DOT marks the same 4 of 6 edges the oracle does, verified line by line, and dot-engine lays out the oracle's own DOT identically to real graphviz (same node ys after offset). The rise comes from a SEPARATE, pre-existing defect in this fixture -- our edge label boxes are ~5x the jar's (WIDTH=346/156 against 72/67) -- and removing an edge from rank constraints changes how those oversized labels push nodes around. Fix that sizing and this number should fall well below 143; see .agent-notes/description-edge-label-oversizing.md. NOT papered over: the same change moved this fixture 143 -> 133 before norank was wired, so the structural paths alone improve it.
